nodes.rationale: Danger must always be visible and consciously chosen; green zones never trigger a chase.

nodes.label: Police pressure and escape as market differentiator
nodes.community_name: Police pressure and escape as market differentiator
nodes.norm_label: police pressure and escape as market differentiator
nodes.rationale: Search-sell-upgrade loops alone are not unique (DUMP, Prospecting!, Dumpster Divers!); no direct competitor uses police pressure.

nodes.label: Dig deeper (push-your-luck)
nodes.rationale: Dig deeper discards the current find; without that swap it would always be the best choice and there would be no decision.

nodes.label: Drop & Run
nodes.rationale: The player always has a self-chosen way out of a chase.

nodes.label: Perfect Dig (dig layer timing)
nodes.rationale: Light skill element without a heavy minigame; tap-to-start instead of hold because holding plus tapping DIG needs two thumbs on mobile.

nodes.label: Rummage (pick 1 of 3 weighted bags)
nodes.rationale: Weight hints are deliberately noisy; showing the other bags tells the player what they nearly got.

nodes.label: Vision cone / spotlight police fallback (3-day timebox)
nodes.norm_label: vision cone / spotlight police fallback (3-day timebox)
nodes.rationale: Roblox NPC pathfinding often snags on curbs and doors; if chase is still janky after 3 days, replace it rather than extend the timebox.

nodes.label: Fun gate (5 strangers play 15+ min)

nodes.label: The Reveal (core pillar)
nodes.rationale: Every dumpster should feel like opening a gift; the 50th must be as fun as the first. Moved to Phase 1 so the core moment is proven before building the map.
